paragraphs: I study IT and I am most interested in what runs underneath applications: Linux, networks and how to secure them. I build things in my own virtual lab, because there I can break them and find out why they broke.
At school I also build websites and applications, so I can finish the interface that runs on top of the infrastructure too.
